verdict.rationale: Bolna documents Bring Your Own Telephony, which lets you connect any standards-compliant SIP trunk and use your own numbers and calling rates instead of its built-in Twilio/Plivo telephony. Telephony providers can also be connected from Settings → Integrations. missing for 10: explicit evidence of importing Twilio/Telnyx numbers or PBX-specific setup, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SIP trunking flow.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: Instead of using Bolna's built-in telephony providers (Twilio, Plivo, etc.), you can use your existing SIP trunk provider, your own phone numbers, and your own calling rates.
Bring Your Own Telephony (BYOT) lets you connect any standards-compliant SIP trunk to the Bolna platform.
Every provider you can bring to Bolna — telephony, LLM, TTS, STT and tools — is connected from a single place in the dashboard: Settings → Integrations.
